description: Create ordinary expense reports by date/client/project/trip/category/merchant. For saved setups, accountant records or persona worksheets, use review_report_setup and its app links. Tags group clients/projects/codes/trips; list_tags if unclear. excludePersonal=true excludes Personal tag and Personal expense category. Returns summary, exact report/Bill Client links, filters and prefilled Report Wizard for visual criteria. shareWith emails only user-named recipients. No server preview: creates on call. Group reports exclude rows on other ordinary reports. No unreported matches: explain existing Reports; never duplicate. Use role-aware accountingHandoffUrls only for the requested destination; opening is not export proof. Skip check_compliance/get_report_details/tax/deductibility analysis unless explicitly requested.

excludePersonal.description: Exclude both Personal-tagged and Personal-category expenses.

recipientRole.description: All recipients: reviewer for one report (comments, approval, changes). Use accountant only for explicitly requested ongoing report management and accounting-software access.

shareWith.description: Email addresses to share the report with

tags.description: Include existing client, project, code, property or trip groups. Check list_tags if unsure.

name: create_report
